evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is part of the live custom-interface registry family.
The builder contains the exact title 'Well of Good Will' and explanatory text 'The well of goodwill seeks..'.
The screen owns exact server-wide progress presentation including '0% (0/100)', '<u=16776960>Server wide progress</u>' and a server-wide reward description.
Exact controls/literals include 'Donate to well of goodwill', '<img=9> Contribute', Divine spirit shield contribution text and individual Goodwill Points reward text.
The builder uses exact 'fountain/sprite' presentation resources, fixing this as the Well of Good Will client interface.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 literal-backed client interface identity; server-side contribution/reward rules are not inferred.
